```yaml
name: Sync Open WebUI

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at 2 AM
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-open-webui:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Remove leftover submodule
        run: |
          if [ -d "open-webui" ]; then
            rm -rf open-webui
          fi
          git rm -f open-webui || true

      - name: Clone Open WebUI as shallow copy
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 --no-checkout https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui.git open-webui
          cd open-webui
          git checkout HEAD -- .
          rm -rf .git

      - name: Update contributor docs
        run: |
          echo "# Open WebUI Integration" >> CONTRIBUTING.md
          echo "" >> CONTRIBUTING.md
          echo "This project includes a shallow copy of Open WebUI for development purposes." >> CONTRIBUTING.md
          echo "The Open WebUI directory is automatically synced weekly." >> CONTRIBUTING.md

      - name: Update README
        run: |
          sed -i '/## Development/a ## Open WebUI Sync\n\nOpen WebUI is automatically synced weekly from the upstream repository.' README.md

      - name: Exclude cloned repo from builds
        run: |
          echo "open-webui/" >> .gitignore

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pip install nox
          nox -s lint tests

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add -A
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore: sync open-webui from upstream"
            git push
          fi
```
